sections.p: Every day you get three missions from the tracks you chose, four on Push me unless you have only 5–15 minutes a day. They're picked to fit the time you said you have. A day runs from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM, so a late night counts as the day it started.
Don't want one? Swap it for another before you prove it. One swap a day, three with Full Edition. A mission you swap stays away for a few weeks.

Do the mission for real, then prove it with the camera in the app: one photo, a photo of the result, a photo before and after, or the focus timer and then a photo. Proof has to be taken in the last 30 minutes, and a photo can only count once.
The checks run on this phone. They look at when and how the photo was taken, never at what's in it. Nobody reviews your photos and no AI looks at them.
Each proven mission earns its points once. Points come only from proven missions.
list: Perfect day, every mission proven: 15 more.

sections.p: Your streak is the days in a row you proved at least one mission. Today counts once you prove one. Until then, yesterday's streak stands.
Miss a day and an Off Day covers it, so the streak keeps going. You earn one every 7 days you show up. You can bank two.
The points from each mission add to its track's level. Milestones mark your first mission, your first perfect day, 7 days, 30 missions and more.
Photos stay on this phone. They're deleted after 30 days unless you choose 1 year or Keep in Settings. The mission, its points and your streak stay.
Points trade for rewards at unsetld.com, and the days you prove at least one mission open more. What's on offer can change with each collection; Rewards shows what's open now.
list: 300 points: free shipping on one order.
600 points: 10% off one order, up to $25 off.
1,000 points: 15% off one order, up to $25 off.
One code for each reward each collection. Codes work for 30 days.
Day 7: every UNSETLD drop opens to you 24 hours before the public.
Day 90: a woven patch with your number, free with your next order.
Day 365: the 365 piece, made only for people who reach a year. It's sold at full price and never restocked.

One code for each reward each collection, and one code per order. Up to $25 off an order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code, and exclude the 365 piece. One patch per person.
Points and access come only from proven missions. Full Edition doesn't change them, and none of it is for sale.
To use a reward or access you need a free account, made with Sign in with Apple, so unsetld.com can hold your place. Your photos stay on this phone.
For US residents 13 and over. If you're under 18, get a parent's or guardian's OK before you place an order.
Points and access are earned only by proving missions in the app. They can't be bought, and Full Edition doesn't change them.

Each mission proven in the app earns its points once: 10 for a quick win, 15 for progress, 25 for a challenge, and 15 more when every mission in the day is proven. Proof must be your own photo of that mission, taken with the camera in the app. Points from earlier versions of the app carry over. We may remove points earned through misuse, such as proof that isn't of the mission.

300 points can be traded for free shipping on one order, 600 points for 10% off one order and 1,000 points for 15% off one order. Discounts take up to $25 off. You can take one code for each reward each collection. Codes are single use, work for 30 days and are only valid at unsetld.com. The rewards on offer, their points and their dates are shown in the app and may change with each collection.

Access counts the days you prove at least one mission. Early access opens drops 24 hours before the public from Day 7. The patch is one per person and ships free with an order from Day 90. The 365 piece is sold at full price from Day 365.

No cash value. Not transferable. Points, codes and access can't be sold, bought or exchanged for money. One code per order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code, and exclude the 365 piece.
Once early access is open, if 14 days pass without a proven mission, it pauses until you prove a mission on 7 more days. Your count, points and milestones stay.
We may change or end the program with 30 days' notice in the app. Points already earned can still be traded for 30 days after it ends.

UNSETLD gives you daily missions, a camera to prove them, points, a streak, levels, programs, reminders and rewards. It is motivation, not medical, financial or professional advice. Do missions within your limits, and swap any that don't suit you.

Full Edition is sold through Apple as an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies.
Rewards and access to the clothing brand have their own terms, in Settings and on the Rewards screen.
The missions and everything else in the app are original to UNSETLD. Your proof photos are yours and stay on your phone.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
Your missions, your answers about you, your streak, points and proof photos live on your iPhone. There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics SDKs.

Purchases: Apple processes payments, and RevenueCat (our subscription provider) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase history so Full Edition works across your devices. Time check: the app asks unsetld.com for the current date so streaks stay honest. No identifier is sent. Config: the app reads small public files from unsetld.com to know whether rewards and access are on, which rewards are offered and when drops open.

The camera is used only when you prove a mission. Photos are saved inside the app on this iPhone and the app never uploads them. Each photo is re-encoded when it's saved, which removes its metadata, including location. Photos are deleted after 30 days unless you choose 1 year or Keep in Settings; the mission and its points stay. Like other app files, they can be part of your own iPhone backup.

Proof is checked on this phone: that the photos were taken just now, in the right order, after the timer, and weren't used before. The checks don't look at what's in a photo. There is no facial recognition, no AI and no one reviewing your photos.
Missions never ask for photos of your face or body, other people, IDs, addresses, bank details, grades, medical information or private conversations, or for your location. There is no public feed.
Your answers (school, work, gym, a project, your age range) and your tracks only decide which missions you get. They stay on your phone.

sections.h: If you sign in for rewards or access
sections.p: Signing in with Apple is optional and only needed to use rewards and access. We receive an Apple user ID and, if you choose, a private relay email. We store the days you proved a mission and each day's number of proven missions and points (dates and numbers only, never photos) so we can hold your place and issue single-use codes. We also keep a token from Apple so we can end the Sign in with Apple link when you delete your account. Nothing else.
Mission reminders and the focus timer alert are local notifications scheduled on your phone. Drop alerts are separate, off by default, and only on if you turn them on.
Links to unsetld.com open in Safari, which is covered by that site's privacy policy.

Delete the app to remove its data and proof photos from your phone. A copy of your record (missions, points and streak, never photos) is kept in your iPhone's Keychain so a reinstall picks up where you left off; iOS can keep it after the app is deleted, and it's never uploaded. To delete an account, open Settings in the app, then Account, then Delete account. We remove the account and what we hold for it, and end the Sign in with Apple link. You can also email unsetldclothing@gmail.com from the address on the account.
UNSETLD is for people 13 and older. We don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. If you think a child under 13 has signed in, email us and we'll delete the account.
